import sys
from collections import deque

def main():
    n = int(sys.stdin.readline())
    p = [-1] * (n + 1)  # 1-based indexing
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        p[i] = int(sys.stdin.readline())

    # Build adjacency list for the hierarchy (manager -> subordinates)
    adj = [[] for _ in range(n + 1)]
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        if p[i] != -1:
            adj[p[i]].append(i)

    # Compute the longest path from each node to a leaf (height)
    height = [0] * (n + 1)
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        if p[i] == -1:
            # Root node, perform BFS to compute height
            q = deque()
            q.append(i)
            height[i] = 0
            while q:
                u = q.popleft()
                for v in adj[u]:
                    height[v] = height[u] + 1
                    q.append(v)

    # The answer is the maximum height + 1 (since height is 0-based)
    print(max(height) + 1 if n > 0 else 0)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
